page.overview:
Who is Air Devil?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

The Air Devils were introduced in 1992 as part of the Air Commandos subset of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: red helmet and black goggles with red lens; red shirt with black vest and gloves; silver vest details; red pants with black belt and padding on inside legs; black boots.

Accessories: clear square dark visor with peg holes; black "aerial assault hand rifle"; black and green hang glider with red Cobra emblems. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/92/airdevil.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/92/airdevil.shtml Filecard]
